Watts made this hymn from Psalm 29, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength. 2Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness. 3The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters. 4The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic. … 7 more verses PSALM 29 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 29
Give to the Lord, ye sons of fame, Give to the Lord renown and power, Ascribe due honours to his name, And his eternal might adore. STANZA I
Watts's psalms run from Psalm 1 to Psalm 150, several settings to many psalms: 367 hymns. This is number 29. Point at a tick to see the hymn; click it to open that hymn.
